title_zh: MHRA 與 NICE：數位心理健康科技計劃第一階段評估意見徵集
title_en: MHRA and NICE call for evidence on digital mental health technologies phase 1 evaluation
summary_zh: 英國藥品及保健品監管局（MHRA）與 NICE 就 Wellcome 資助的數位心理健康科技計劃第一階段資源展開意見徵集，了解業界、專業人員、研究者及用家對相關資源的接收與使用情況。徵集結果將評估第一階段成果，並為計劃第二階段的方向提供依據。
summary_en: The UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) and NICE opened a call for evidence on resources from phase 1 of the Wellcome-funded Digital Mental Health Technologies programme, seeking views from industry, professionals, researchers and users on how the resources were received and used. Findings will evaluate phase 1 and inform the direction of phase 2.
